msg: You will see a picture with 2 gnomes, the lighter/duller colours (grey and white) tend to give more mushrooms ... between 1 an 9 at a time.  When the number of mushrooms given drops, select the other colours, like the purple.  Then, when that starts to drop, go back to the first instruction, then when the numbers drop, swap again, and continue like this through the duration of the game.
